status: pre-registered: P1 held, P2 mostly failed, P3 not shown
text: Numeric facts follow the same layout as word facts: early neurons act at the name, later neurons at the answer digits
detail: 86 numeric facts, exact per-digit log-odds. Layers 0-19 act at the name tokens (16.55 of 16.83) and not at the answer positions (0.10); layers 20-35 act at the answer positions (10.94 of 12.41; 9.64 of 10.52). Early neurons support ~half of a number's digits, later ones one digit.
evidence_sql: SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE experiment_id = 'numeric_facts' AND evidence_type = 'position_split'

status: pre-registered: B1, B3, B4, B5 held; B2 failed
text: Era-concept neurons carry a century in every answer format and across languages; format-bound digit neurons sit beside them
detail: 26 century neurons x 280 entities: median AUC 0.87-0.94 in year / century / decade / period answers vs 0.51-0.60 for random neurons; weak when the entity is only named (0.60). Activation is format-free but necessity is format-bound (L31:8930 needed for year / decade answers, not '19th century').

status: pre-registered: A1 failed as a neuron property, A2 held as push-pull, A3 held modestly
text: No neuron codes number size; the number line lives in the digit tokens' output vectors
detail: Dose series -4x..4x on 86 + 43 less-certain numbers: lost probability goes to neighbouring digits equally for random neurons (76% vs 81%); graded responses (36-51% vs 0-2% random) move towards the neuron's own digit in 158 of 159. Digit-token unembedding cosine falls steadily with distance (0.78 -> 0.67).

text: L31:8930 carries 'the 1800s': it fires for 19th-century entities whatever the answer format, is needed for their years and decades, and pushes mid/late-19th-century history words
detail: AUC 0.96 / 0.92 / 0.95 / 0.90 (year / century / decade / period). Zeroing it: year answers -1.43, decade -2.52, '19th century' -0.12 (median, in-era; out-of-era 0.00). Numeric facts: hurts 18 of 27 years 18xx and nothing else. facts2: the '19th century' answer-value neuron. Readout (informal): Victorian, Civil, Reconstruction, Taiping, Cixi. In run 1 it matters for 1800s history concepts (Isma'il Pasha, Second Opium War, Anglo-Zulu War, Paris Commune).
evidence_sql: SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE unit_key = 'L31:8930' AND (passes OR evidence_type IN ('readout_tokens','activation_auc'))

text: Every knockout here is single-neuron and format-specific: redundant neurons can carry a concept without a large single drop
detail: L31:8930 is active for '19th century' answers (AUC 0.92) but zeroing it costs them only 0.12; L33:2629 is the mirror. Read 'needed' (knockout) and 'carries' (activation AUC) as different kinds of evidence.
